Deduplicated melanoma workflow

Version 2 reporting boundary. Primary ranking is unweighted mean outer-fold ROC-AUC; AP is secondary. An inner-validation pilot or uncertainty experiment has no five-fold estimate, so its ROC-AUC is explicitly exploratory. The saved image recipes, AP-selected checkpoints/epochs and AP-based admission gates remain unchanged and are labelled historical selection rules. This is a presentation migration, not a ROC-selected image refit. Executing every cell reads saved artifacts and writes only new v2 reports: no image smoke, checkpoint inference, training, calibration fitting, cutoff selection, final all-development fit or reserved-test access occurs. The added metadata experiment uses its own explicit v2 ROC selection identity.

tl;dr

This report separates an evaluation-only sensitivity check from a clean training and selection experiment. It reads existing development artifacts and checks their receipts; executing it never starts training, fits a calibrator, chooses a cutoff or opens the reserved test.

The audit confirms 158 exact-copy pairs. The manifest retains 6,706 images, 127 malignant images, 422 patients and 88 malignant patients. Existing images and experiments are preserved. The execution table below records what is complete at report time; incomplete image stages contribute no final metrics.

Context & Methods

The question is whether retaining identical copies affected the model comparisons and conclusions. The primary outcome is unweighted mean outer-fold ROC-AUC; mean-fold AP is secondary. Pooled outcomes are secondary because separately fitted folds can have different probability scales.

Key assumptions

  • Exact full-resolution RGB equality defines copies. Distinct photographs and repeated patient records remain. The smallest image ID is retained without predictions or performance.
  • Outer patient assignments and historical inner memberships stay fixed. The NN stopping folds use the original outer-fold column and its original seed-dependent rule.
  • The paired bootstrap resamples whole patients within outer folds, with 2,000 draws and seed 42. Confidence intervals condition on saved fits and omit retraining/selection variability.
  • Development folds influenced earlier pilots. Deduplication does not turn these into an untouched model-selection benchmark. These results are development evidence; clinical benefit and reserved-test generalisation remain unverified.

Load verified saved artifacts

Only canonical development metadata, its frozen manifest and named result artifacts are opened. Tables for incomplete stages are withheld.

def project_path(relative):
    path = (PROJECT_ROOT / relative).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT):
        raise ValueError("Result paths must stay inside this project.")
    return path

def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()

def read_json(relative):
    return json.loads(project_path(relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def check_hashes(hashes, base=PROJECT_ROOT):
    base = Path(base).resolve()
    for relative, expected in hashes.items():
        path = (base / relative).resolve()
        if not path.is_relative_to(base) or sha256(path) != expected:
            raise ValueError(f"Saved provenance check failed: {relative}")

# Audit/profile values are reconciled against only the allowed development IDs.
def development_profile(frame):
    age = pd.to_numeric(frame.age_approx, errors="raise")
    ages = frame.assign(age_numeric=age).groupby("patient_id").age_numeric
    count = frame.groupby("patient_id").size()
    site = frame.anatom_site_general_challenge.astype("string").str.strip().str.casefold()
    missing_site = site.isna() | site.isin(["", "unknown", "missing"])
    return {"images": len(frame), "malignant_images": int(frame.target.sum()),
            "patients": int(frame.patient_id.nunique()),
            "malignant_patients": int(frame.loc[frame.target.eq(1), "patient_id"].nunique()),
            "missing_age_images": int(age.isna().sum()), "missing_site_images": int(missing_site.sum()),
            "patients_with_multiple_recorded_ages": int(ages.nunique().gt(1).sum()),
            "patients_with_age_span_at_least_15": int((ages.max() - ages.min()).ge(15).sum()),
            "patient_image_count_min": int(count.min()), "patient_image_count_max": int(count.max()),
            "top_ten_patients_image_fraction": float(count.nlargest(10).sum() / len(frame))}

for population, frame in (("original", original), ("retained", retained)):
    measured = development_profile(frame)
    for field, value in measured.items():
        recorded = audit[population + "_profile"][field]
        assert np.isclose(value, recorded), (population, field, value, recorded)

def load_sensitivity(run_id, required=True):
    folder = project_path("results/dedup_v1/sensitivity/" + run_id)
    receipt_path = folder / "completion_receipt.json"
    if not receipt_path.is_file():
        if required:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Complete sensitivity report is required: {run_id}")
        return None
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert receipt["status"] == "complete"
    assert receipt["dataset"] == dataset_identity
    check_hashes(receipt["input_sha256"])
    check_hashes(receipt["artifact_sha256"], folder)
    return {"folder": folder, "receipt": receipt, "summary": receipt["summary"]}

Data-quality findings and review examples

Recorded ages and anatomical sites stay unchanged. Capture dates and annotation truth cannot be established from these records. Patient bootstrap accounts for dependence, while equal-patient weighting separately checks the influence of patients with many images. Quality measurements are review flags; they are not exclusion rules.

Actual execution status

A complete training stage requires all five outer folds and verified evaluation artifacts. A partial run is never promoted to a full comparison.

Code cell 11 · execution 7
def pilot_status(run_id):
    folder = project_path("results/image_d1_runs/" + run_id)
    summary_path = folder / "summary.json"
    if not summary_path.is_file():
        return {"Stage": run_id, "Status": "pending; no complete receipt", "Evidence": "not promoted"}
    receipt = json.loads(summary_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if receipt.get("status") != "complete":
        return {"Stage": run_id, "Status": str(receipt.get("status", "pending")), "Evidence": "not promoted"}
    receipt = load_complete_pilot(folder)
    declaration = json.loads((folder / "run_manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert declaration["dataset_identity"] == dataset_identity
    return {"Stage": run_id, "Status": "complete, verified exploratory pilot", "Evidence": "conditional inner validation only"}

Secondary patient weighting, site support and frozen decision scenarios

Equal-patient weights sum to one for each patient. These answer a different weighting question from the primary image-level comparison. Site subgroups are descriptive and may be too sparse for stable conclusions. Blank AP/AUC entries represent undefined metrics.

Clean image results and the three conditions

Condition 1 is historical training/original evaluation. Condition 2 is historical training/retained evaluation. Condition 3 is clean training and selection/retained evaluation. Comparing 2 with 3 measures their combined training and selection influence; the fits change, so it is not an isolated training-only effect.

Takeaways

The completed sensitivity evidence assesses evaluation weighting. At the historical sensitivity report's preparation, a conclusion about clean image training awaited verified five-fold outputs; those clean outputs now appear in clean notebook 09, alongside the original-data evaluation in notebook 14. Keep evaluation-only filtering separate from clean retraining even when the reported rankings agree.

Fusion must later use matching clean training-only predictions, with an image-only versus image-plus-metadata control. Calibration, cutoffs, subgroup figures and uncertainty/referral results must be regenerated from their matching clean runs before carrying those conclusions forward. Existing uncertainty results remain historical.
